CVE-2026-53615 is a libblkid DOS-partition bounds/overflow issue, reachable only when libblkid parses a block device or disk image. datahub-actions never parses block devices (Python event processor; no blkid/fdisk/partition tooling in its runtime), so the vulnerable code path is not executed. No fix is available in Debian trixie.

CVE-2026-53614 is a libmount SUID-hardening issue affecting restricted users invoking a multi-step legacy mount(2). datahub-actions runs nonroot and never invokes mount, so the vulnerable code path is not executed. No fix is available in Debian trixie.

CVE-2026-53613 is a libmount TOCTOU on the mount target, reachable only while mounting a filesystem. datahub-actions never performs mount operations (Python event processor, nonroot), so the vulnerable code path is not executed. No fix is available in Debian trixie.

CVE-2026-53612 is a libmount fd-based ownership/mode flaw exercised during a mount operation. util-linux ships here only as a base-OS package; datahub-actions is a Python event-processing app that runs nonroot and never performs mount operations (no mount/umount, no libmount-using tooling in its runtime), so the vulnerable code path is not executed. No fix is available in Debian trixie.
